name: Mississippi
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (federal ADA Title II floor only)

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: ITS: ADA Rule Update — New Federal Accessibility Requirements

applies_to: State agencies and local governments via ADA Title II; no state-specific web accessibility statute or enterprise policy found.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: No state-specific requirements verified; ADA Title II rule obligations apply
mobile: implied — ITS notice says the federal rule covers websites, mobile apps and electronic documents.
procurement: No state accessibility procurement clause or VPAT requirement found.
enforcement: ADA Title II (DOJ / private action). ITS accessibility contact: Accessibility@its.ms.gov.
notes: No Mississippi statute or ITS enterprise accessibility policy located; one search summary claimed a WCAG 1.0 state policy but no primary source was found, so it is not included. The ITS page lists stale dates (2026-04-26 / 2027-04-26) that match neither the original rule nor the 2026 extension.
